title: Update: Qingyue's IPO sponsor, auditor and actual controller set up a 370 million RMB fund to compensate investors
content: On October 23, 2026, Qingyue Technology's IPO sponsor GF Securities announced that it has set up a 370 million RMB (around $55.5 million USD) special fund to compensate investors who lost money in the company's shares. title: Counterpoint: laptop mini-LED shipments to drop 75% within two years, as OLED takes over the premium laptop market
content: According to new estimates from Counterpoint Research (DSCS), global shipments of mini-LED panels for laptops will decrease by 38% in 2026, and by a further 60% in 2027 - so 2027 shipments will reach only about 25% of their 2025 level. Laptop OLED panel shipments, on the other hand, are projected to grow by 50% in 2026 and by another 24% in 2027, while the overall laptop display market is expected to shrink by 3% this year.

title: Meta prioritizes high-margin AI inference as Wiwynn, Quanta eye CPU server demand
content: Meta has become the first of the four major US hyperscale cloud providers to report its latest earnings, with supply chain players closely monitoring changes in the company's capital expenditure plans and investment priorities.

title: Podcast highlights: TSMC's 3nm demand story, Samsung HBM shift, and A14 ramp
content: Following TSMC's third-quarter 2026 earnings call, DIGITIMES analyst Luke Lin provided in a podcast additional analysis of several details that received limited attention in market coverage, including a new 3nm fab at the Southern Taiwan Science Park (STSP), the transfer of Nvidia-related high-bandwidth memory (HBM) base die orders to TSMC, and whether demand for A14 includes Intel server CPUs.
